payload.title: Integrate existing console with central Prospectus accounts
payload.description: Cross-project initiative Prospectus kanbus-4b25e2, epic kanbus-c32497, integration kanbus-e1dbe6. Reuse trace-ui and Python web_api. First increment: typed server-side accounts gateway, temporary-runtime-credential IAM SigV4 transport, fail-closed account/person/product authorization binding, synthetic specs. Live slice blocked on exact runtime hosting/persistence, runtime role approval, OAuth callback, and agreed read/write permission contract. No central database duplication.
